article.title: 4 November: different market clocks
article.substack_body_markdown:
## What moved when

The review places gold's upward move at 05:00-07:00 UTC (12:00-14:00 Bangkok), with US500 turning up from 04:00 UTC (11:00 Bangkok).

The review places Bitcoin's largest upward leg at 14:00-15:00 UTC (21:00-22:00 Bangkok).

The review says oil fell throughout the day, with its largest leg at 12:00-17:00 UTC (19:00-24:00 Bangkok).

source_pack.canonical_content_text:
D_SWEEP: Democratic House and Democratic Senate (most likely)

Our own dossier got the direction wrong for risk assets. DOS §6.1 mapped a Democratic sweep to US500 down, USTEC down and BTC down, following strategists (Hartnett, Yardeni). The sweep came, and those markets rose. The gold-up and USD-down legs were right.

Jim's question: when did each market move on 4 Nov?

Gold 05:00-07:00Z (12:00-14:00)

US500 04:00Z (11:00) A steady climb through Asia and Europe:

BTC First leg 04:00-08:00Z Largest leg 14:00-15:00Z (21:00-22:00, US session)

USOIL It fell all day. The largest leg was in the US session, 12:00-17:00Z (19:00-24:00)

"Only in the US session" holds for Bitcoin's breakout and oil's slide. It does not hold for gold, silver and US500. Gold moved at noon Vietnam time, as the Senate calls came in. US500 turned at 11:00 and climbed all through Asia and Europe.
